bloques.titulo: The double mark of the weak masculine accuser
texto: When formulating the masculine direct object of a weak noun, both the article or adjective and the noun itself must be in line with the flexsive desinence:
- **Ich kenne den neuen Kollegen** (I know the new partner).
- **Wir unterstützen den engagierten Assistenten** (we support the engaged assistant).
- **Der Chef empfängt einen ausländischen Journalisten** (the chief receives a foreign journalist).
This morphological feature is unique to the weak class masculine and prevents errors of agreement in professional records B2.

frases.de: Unser Vertriebsteam betreut täglich jeden anspruchsvollen Kunden mit größter Sorgfalt.
frases.es: Nuestro equipo de ventas atiende a diario a cada cliente exigente con el mayor esmero.
frases.en: Our sales team attends every demanding customer every day with the greatest care.

frases.de: Wir unterstützen den engagierten Assistenten bei der Vorbereitung der Präsentation.
frases.es: Apoyamos al entregado asistente en la preparación de la presentación.
frases.en: We support the dedicated assistant in the preparation of the presentation.
analisis: in the preparation of the submission

frases.de: Der Geschäftsführer empfängt heute den ausländischen Journalisten zu einem Interview.
frases.es: El director general recibe hoy al periodista extranjero para una entrevista.
frases.en: The director general is now receiving the foreign journalist for an interview.

frases.de: Durch diese professionelle Beratung gewinnen wir das Vertrauen jedes Geschäftspartners.
frases.es: Mediante este asesoramiento profesional nos ganamos la confianza de cada socio comercial.
frases.en: Through this professional advice, we gain the confidence of every business partner.

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct form of the direct object for «der Assistent» with a given article?

opciones.explicacion: The article passes to «den» and the weak noun takes the mandatory «-» desinence.
It is incorrect to omit the «-» termination in the weak noun.
«der» does not correspond to the masculine accusative mark.

bloques.frase: Die Marketingagentur berät seit vielen Jahren jeden anspruchsvollen ___ .

opciones.explicacion: «der Kunde» is a weak masculine that adds «-n» in accusative: «jeden Kunden».
Undiminished form of nominative, agrammatic as direct object.
End in -s non-existent in the N-Deklination.

bloques.pregunta: What does this press release communicate?
bloques.frase: Der Geschäftsführer empfängt heute den Journalisten zu einem Interview.

opciones.texto: That the Director-General will hold a briefing with the press professional.
opciones.explicacion: «den Journalisten» is the singular accuser of «der Journalist».

opciones.texto: That the journalist has refused to ask questions to the company's management.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates that the Director General receives it for the interview.

opciones.texto: That a number of journalists spoke to the headquarters of the business group.
opciones.explicacion: It is singular («den Journalisten»), not collective plural protest.

bloques.pregunta: What disinence does the «der Nachbar» noun add when it functions as a direct object in accusative?

opciones.texto: Add «-n»: «Ich habe meinen Nachbarn im Treppenhaus getroffen».
opciones.explicacion: «der Nachbar» belongs to the N-Deklination and takes the «-n» desinence.

opciones.texto: It does not add any termination because it is a neutral, invariable noun.
opciones.explicacion: It is a masculine noun of person who declines with oblique deinence.
This termination corresponds to strong or adjetival genitive flexion.

bloques.frase: Die Polizei befragte den mutigen ___ über den Vorfall am Bahnhof.

opciones.explicacion: «der Zeuge» (nominee) becomes «den Zeugen» in an indicative case.
It lacks the mandatory mark of a weak accusative.

bloques.pregunta: Who is assisted by the phrase?
bloques.frase: Wir unterstützen den engagierten Assistenten bei seiner täglichen Arbeit.

opciones.texto: To a single singular assistant collaborator that shows great commitment.
opciones.explicacion: «den Assistenten» is a weak singular accuser preceded by «den».

opciones.texto: To a large group of students attending a university conference.
opciones.explicacion: It's singular individualized, not a plural collective.

opciones.texto: To the human resources management that coordinates temporary contracts.
opciones.explicacion: The specific assistant is supported in his daily tasks.

bloques.frase: wir betreuen jeden Kunden mit großer Sorgfalt
bloques.traduccion: we care for each customer with great care
bloques.explicacion: double flexation of accusative in determinant and weak substantive.

intro: We focus on the **caso acusativo** of the N-Deklination, where the student must coordinate the double mark: the **-en** termination of the determinant and the **-(e)n** termination of the weak noun.
